title: 2982. Find Longest Special Substring That Occurs Thrice II

examples.explanation: The longest special substring which occurs thrice is "aa": substrings "aaaa", "aaaa", and "aaaa". It can be shown that the maximum length achievable is 2.
There exists no special substring which occurs at least thrice. Hence return -1.
The longest special substring which occurs thrice is "a": substrings "abcaba", "abcaba", and "abcaba". It can be shown that the maximum length achievable is 1.

hints: Let len[i] be the length of the longest special string ending with s[i].
Group all the len[i] by s[i]. We have at most 26 groups.
The maximum value of the third largest len[i] in each group is the answer.
We only need to maintain the top three values for each group. You can use sorting, heap, or brute-force comparison to find the third largest value in each group.
